theme: Axon guidance by semaphorin and netrin cues
core_role: The shared pathways are the Sema3A-driven repulsive guidance machinery (plexin/CRMP/PAK signalling, integrin inhibition, microtubule destabilization) that restrains and steers axon extension during nerve branching and innervation, complemented by netrin attraction and repulsion.

theme: FGF23/Klotho and PTH control of phosphate and mineralization
core_role: The shared pathways are the endocrine phosphate-regulating axis (FGF23-FGFR1c/Klotho and PTH signalling acting on SLC34A1 sodium-phosphate transport) that sets renal phosphate reabsorption and thereby bone mineralization, with the type II Na+/Pi cotransporters as its effectors.

theme: Dendritic spine and dendrite structural plasticity
core_role: The shared pathways are actin-based maintenance and remodelling of the postsynaptic density and dendritic spines, framed as the fine-scale structural plasticity of synapses within broader dendrite arborization.

theme: Presynaptic modulation of inhibitory GABAergic transmission
core_role: The shared pathways are presynaptic control of transmitter release (Gbeta/gamma inhibition of Ca2+ channels, GIRK activation, kainate receptors, presynaptic potential and calcium) used to tune GABAergic and glutamatergic transmission, alongside inhibitory synapse assembly.

theme: Hexosamine and sialic acid supply for glycoconjugate synthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are amino-sugar metabolism (GFPT1-driven UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, GNE sialic acid, mannose and GlcNAc turnover) framed as the sugar-donor supply feeding glycoconjugate assembly such as GPI anchors.

theme: Centrosome and microtubule control of spindle positioning
core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome/MTOC positioning and microtubule dynamics (nucleation, anchoring, severing, polymerization control) used to orient and position the mitotic spindle for asymmetric cell division.

theme: Lipoxygenase-derived lipid mediators and inflammation resolution
core_role: The shared pathways are the biosynthesis of specialized pro-resolving mediators (lipoxins, resolvins, protectins, maresins) as the resolution arm of lipoxygenase oxylipin metabolism, which also produces hepoxilins and 12-HETE derivatives.

theme: Neutrophil and mucosal antimicrobial defense
core_role: The shared pathways are innate antimicrobial effector mechanisms (neutrophil degranulation, antimicrobial peptides, metal and heme sequestration, cytolysis, agglutination, mucus secretion) used to kill and contain bacteria and fungi.

theme: DNA double-strand break repair: NHEJ and homologous recombination
core_role: The shared pathways are DSB sensing and ATM/BRCA1/BRCA2 signalling plus the end-joining routes, framed as the damage response and repair-pathway choice upstream of the homologous recombination mechanics (resection, strand exchange, D-loop resolution, SSA).

theme: COPII/COPI vesicle trafficking between ER and Golgi
core_role: The shared pathways are coat-mediated anterograde (COPII cargo loading and export) and retrograde (COPI) transport between ER and Golgi that underlies protein exit from the ER.

theme: Insulin signaling and glucose uptake regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are insulin receptor-IRS-AKT2 signalling and its attenuation, controlling glycogen synthesis and glucose import as the core of metabolic insulin sensitivity, with GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin signalling as effectors and modulators.

theme: Integrated stress response and translational control
core_role: The shared pathways are eIF2alpha kinase (GCN2, HRI, PERK) and UPR-linked control of translation initiation, framed as the cell's translational response to nutrient, heme, ER and mitochondrial stress.

theme: Endolysosomal fusion and autophagic delivery to lysosomes
core_role: The shared pathways are the membrane fusion and transport steps that deliver late endosomes, multivesicular bodies and autophagosomes to lysosomes, within broader control of endolysosomal organelle size and traffic.

theme: Glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC-mediated reuptake and homeostasis of glutamate/aspartate and GABA (with transporter disease variants), framed as transmitter clearance and recycling alongside GABA synthesis/degradation and cholinergic transport.

theme: Lung development from branching to alveolar differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are early lung organogenesis (epithelial bud branching, mesenchymal proliferation, lobe growth, pulmonary vasculature and perinatal ductus closure) as the morphogenetic groundwork preceding saccule formation and pneumocyte differentiation.

theme: Ribosomal RNA transcription by RNA polymerases I and III
core_role: The shared pathways are the Pol I transcription cycle (preinitiation, promoter opening and escape, elongation, termination) with its chromatin-remodelling regulators plus Pol III 5S rRNA synthesis, framed as rRNA output that is also repressed via SIRT1 and nucleolar chromatin.

theme: Thymic T cell development and selection
core_role: The shared pathways are thymocyte proliferation, survival, positive selection and lineage differentiation (double positive, gamma-delta) as the T cell developmental program, extended toward CD8 differentiation and costimulation.

theme: Renal sodium transport and cellular osmoregulation
core_role: The shared pathways are aldosterone-regulated sodium and chloride transport and osmosensory responses to hyper- and hypotonicity, framed as salt and water homeostasis linked to renin-angiotensin blood pressure control.

theme: Embryonic axis patterning and neural plate regionalization
core_role: The shared pathways are early anterior-posterior and dorsal-ventral patterning of the neural plate and hindbrain (HOX activation, rhombomeres, midbrain-hindbrain boundary, neural crest specification), framed as positional-identity specification also redeployed in limb and digit morphogenesis.

theme: Type I interferon antiviral innate immunity
core_role: The shared pathways are RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TRAF3/TRAF6-IRF7/NF-kB signalling and interferon-stimulated effectors (ISG15, OAS) together with viral evasion, as the core antiviral innate response that also includes IRF3 induction, DNA sensing and dendritic cell activation.

theme: Ubiquitin-proteasome system and deubiquitination
core_role: The shared pathways are ubiquitin chain synthesis and linkage-specific editing by DUB families together with proteasome assembly and degradation, framed as protein turnover control, with neddylation/COP9 regulation of cullin ligases as the additional layer.

theme: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycan catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are hexosamine, sialic acid and mannose metabolism framed as glycan breakdown and recycling (lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism), with lysosomal sialidase, sialin export and hexosaminidase disorders as the additional context.

theme: Intestinal carbohydrate digestion and hexose absorption
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC2/SLC5 hexose transport of glucose, galactose and fructose across intestinal and renal epithelia, framed as the absorption step following dietary disaccharide digestion.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport for glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis of UDP-sugars and CMP-sialic acid and their SLC35 transport into the Golgi, framed as donor supply for glycosylation (with CDG disorders) consumed by GPI-anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis.

theme: Cobalamin and biotin cofactor metabolism disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are vitamin B12 uptake, transport and intracellular processing for MUT and MTR (methylmalonic acidemia, homocystinuria) linked to propionyl-CoA catabolism, framed as cofactor-dependent carboxylase/mutase metabolism alongside biotin recycling defects.

theme: Cellular responses to heavy metals and metal detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are MTF1/metallothionein-mediated responses to diverse metal ions, framed as metal stress handling and detoxification, of which cadmium transport and detoxification is a specific case.

theme: B cell activation, germinal centres and humoral memory
core_role: The shared pathways are BCR signalling, T follicular helper co-stimulation (ICOS, CD27) and germinal centre B cell proliferation and differentiation toward memory, framed as the activation program that culminates in plasma cell and immunoglobulin output.

theme: Amino acid biosynthesis and vitamin B6-dependent metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are non-essential amino acid synthesis and catabolism (glycine, proline, aspartate and glutamine families, glyoxylate), framed as the PLP-dependent transamination network linked to serine metabolism and vitamin B6 activation.

theme: Inhibitory Fc receptor and SIRP signalling in immune cells
core_role: The shared pathways are inhibitory receptor signalling (SIRPalpha, Fc receptor ITIM pathways) that restrains neutrophil activation and phagocytosis, framed as immunoreceptor checkpoints that also tune antibody-mediated humoral and BCR responses.

theme: Cholesterol transport, efflux and sterol homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are LXR-regulated cholesterol import, efflux, storage and reverse cholesterol transport via lipoproteins, framed as cellular sterol balance coupled to feedback on biosynthesis and endocytic uptake.

theme: FGF receptor signaling and its feedback regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are ligand binding (including beta-Klotho) and FRS2/SHC adaptor cascades downstream of FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4, framed as the activating signal arm that Sprouty and FGFRL1 negatively regulate.

theme: Type 2 immunity: Th2, IL-33 and eosinophils
core_role: The shared pathways are IL-33 alarmin signalling and Th2 differentiation driving IL-4/5/13 and mast cell activation against helminths, framed as the type 2 inducer arm whose effector output includes eosinophil recruitment and activation.

theme: Ureteric bud and early kidney morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching that shape the mesonephros and kidney size, framed as the inductive morphogenesis regulated during metanephric development.

theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance of specific neuron types
core_role: The shared pathways are attractive and repulsive control of axon extension for serotonergic, dopaminergic and dorsal root ganglion neurons along the body axes, framed as guidance responses executed through netrin signalling.

theme: Platelet adhesion, activation and hemostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are platelet adhesion to collagen (GPVI, GPIb-IX-V), activation, degranulation and aggregation, framed as primary hemostasis and coagulation whose VWF-ADAMTS13 variants underlie von Willebrand disorders.

theme: Intermembrane lipid transfer and phospholipid turnover
core_role: The shared pathways are non-vesicular transfer of phospholipids, glycolipids and ceramide-1-phosphate between membranes (e.g. PI/PC between ER and Golgi), framed as lipid distribution coupled to lysophospholipid and glycerophospholipid catabolism.

theme: Calcineurin-NFAT driven cardiac hypertrophy
core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organization and cardiac muscle adaptation, framed as the hypertrophic outcome controlled by calcineurin-NFAT signalling.

theme: Myoblast proliferation, differentiation and muscle regeneration
core_role: The shared pathways are myoblast behaviours (migration, proliferation, differentiation, fusion) balanced during skeletal muscle regeneration, framed as the myogenic progression from fate commitment to fiber development.

theme: Excitatory amino acid transport and transporter disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are EAAT-mediated glutamate/aspartate reuptake and intracellular glutamate homeostasis with neurotransmitter-transporter disease variants, framed as transmitter clearance within broader GABA and choline/acetylcholine handling.

theme: Sulfation and glycosaminoglycan metabolism in cartilage
core_role: The shared pathways are PAPS synthesis and transport, sulfate uptake, sulfatase activation and hyaluronan degradation, framed as the sulfation machinery for proteoglycans whose defects cause chondrodysplasias, alongside heparan and chondroitin sulfate biosynthesis.

theme: Growth factor-driven sprouting angiogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are VEGF and FGF receptor signalling promoting endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis, migration and vessel branching, framed as the pro-angiogenic sprouting program alongside endothelial activation, tube morphogenesis and vascular repair.

theme: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and volume
core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin generation and signalling plus peptide catabolism (bradykinin, neuropeptides) regulating renal sodium excretion, urine and blood volume, framed as the renin-angiotensin regulation of systemic arterial pressure.

theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation
core_role: The shared pathways are beta-oxidation of very-long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids via acyl-CoA oxidase and peroxisomal protein processing, framed as peroxisomal lipid catabolism that also performs phytanate alpha-oxidation.

theme: Coronavirus replication and hijacking of host translation
core_role: The shared pathways are viral genome translation and replication (frameshifting, replicase maturation, capping) and SARS-CoV modulation of host translation, framed as viral replication strategies within general viral mRNA synthesis, translation and PKR evasion.

theme: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism and catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are metabolism and breakdown of deoxyribonucleosides and deoxyribonucleotides (including ADA and PNP deficiencies), framed as nucleotide pool homeostasis and salvage feeding pyrimidine catabolism.

theme: N-glycan processing and nucleotide-sugar transport
core_role: The shared pathways are N-linked glycosylation steps (dolichyl-glucose synthesis, glucosidase/mannosidase trimming) and SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transport, framed as glycoprotein processing whose defects cause congenital disorders of glycosylation.

theme: Thymocyte proliferation, survival and selection
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of immature thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis and differentiation, framed as the developmental control of T cells that includes positive selection and gamma-delta lineage commitment.

theme: Base excision repair of damaged DNA bases
core_role: The shared pathways are DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged purines and pyrimidines (OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1, NEIL) and AP-site processing with their defects, framed as the initiating short-patch steps of BER completed by long-patch gap filling.

theme: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine signaling
core_role: The shared pathways are restraint of IL-1/Toll signalling and of proinflammatory cytokine production (IL-1, IL-6, IL-12, TNF), framed as anti-inflammatory braking that extends to NF-kB and TNF signalling inhibition.

theme: Thymic T cell selection and central tolerance
core_role: The shared pathways are thymocyte migration, positive and negative selection, proliferation and apoptosis control and lineage differentiation, framed as central tolerance induction connected to Treg development and control of T cell death.
